$comment: Neutral receiving contract derived independently from GS1 EPCIS 2.0 concepts.

businessStep.description: Business-process step represented by the event.

eventLocation.description: Location associated with the event; read point and business location have distinct valid meanings.

eventTimestamp.description: Time when the traceability event happened.

localTimeOffset.description: UTC offset applicable at the event location.

postEventDisposition.description: Business state expected to hold after the event.

quantityUnit.description: Measurement unit for the observed quantity.

readPointIdentifier.description: Exact capture point for the scan or observation.

sensorTemperature.description: Temperature reported by a sensor attached to the event.

tradeItemInstance.description: Serialized trade-item identity observed by the event.

transformationIdentifier.description: Identifier linking inputs and outputs of a transformation event.
